overall_reason: The file labels are literal ('Launch brief, Updated today, PDF'), but the document preview leads with a stock tagline, 'A simpler way to work together.', and a reflex triad.

score.reason: T-LABEL-READ passes on the file list; T-RIVAL-NAME and T-CADENCE fail on the preview's 'A simpler way to work together.' and 'Shared projects, clear ownership, and one place for feedback.'

findings.evidence: The preview of 'Launch brief' shows the subtitle 'A simpler way to work together.' The line stays true under any collaboration product's name.
findings.after: The brief's own subject: what is launching and when [DATA NEEDED: the launch's name and date]
findings.why: The preview is the one place the product shows document content, and it shows a line that belongs to no one.

findings.where: document preview card, 'The release' section, 1440 and 375 (01-evidence/tiles/1440-00.png)
findings.evidence: The body under 'The release' reads 'Shared projects, clear ownership, and one place for feedback.': three abstract nouns with no fact.
findings.before: "Shared projects, clear ownership, and one place for feedback."
findings.after: One concrete line about the release, for example what changes for whom
findings.why: A three-part list of qualities is the default cadence and says nothing the reader can check.

strengths: The file list states type and recency ('Updated today', 'Updated yesterday', 'PDF').
'Shared with the product team' names the audience.
not_investigated: T-LONG-FORM: no running-text region; the item is a single product composition with under 50 words.
T-FIVE-SECOND and T-RIVAL-NAME on interface labels: skipped, the item is an app component (Operate mode) with no hero; page title and navigation sit outside the capture frame.
T-READ-ALOUD: no brand voice supplied and too few sentences to hear a voice.
Async and after-action states: async.json was not captured, so no state copy after a click was read.
The caption above the frame ('Considered composition') is the capture's teaching label, not the product's copy, and was not judged.
